correctness.rationale: A one-pole Artin-Schreier different yields the complete monomial differential basis. Direct characteristic-two Cartier expansions produce inverse doubling of a modular index, and an antipodal transversal forces C^n=0. Explicit basis differentials have C^(n-1)-images dx and x^2dx (second for n>=5), proving exact sharpness. A standalone checker corroborated examples n=3 through 15 without substituting finite tests for the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The nilpotency index measures the depth of the Cartier filtration of the geometric Jacobian, beyond its previously calculated a-number and p-rank. Establishing sharpness of the maximality nilpotency bound for an infinite canonical family is a natural missing exact geometric invariant. The antipodal indexing and explicit multiple longest chains provide structural understanding, not a routine numerical recomputation.
